title: Step 5a - Interpreting Logistic Regression Plots: Prediction Regions Explained

cues.en: Instructor: Now we're eventually at the final round of our logistic regression model, which is the fun part, because we're going to visualize the training set results as well as the test set results.
cues.zh: 終於來到邏輯斯迴歸最後一輪，也是有趣的部分：視覺化訓練集與測試集。

cues.en: And basically we're gonna make a plot that will represent everything that is happening with our logistic regression model.
cues.zh: 我們會做一張圖，呈現模型中發生的所有事情。

cues.en: So let's make this chart.
cues.zh: 現在繪圖。

cues.en: I'm gonna do like in Python, I'm going to take the code that I've prepared and paste it here.
cues.zh: 和 Python 一樣，取用我準備好的程式碼貼到這裡。

cues.en: I will select and execute the code.
cues.zh: 選取並執行。

cues.en: And then for those of you who are interested in the idea behind the code, that is how the code plots the graph, I will explain how the code works at the end of this tutorial.
cues.zh: 如果你有興趣知道程式如何繪圖，教學最後會解釋。

cues.en: Okay, so right now I'm gonna paste the code.
cues.zh: 現在先貼上程式碼。

cues.en: Here we go.
cues.zh: 完成。

cues.en: Then this code contains 15 lines of code.
cues.zh: 共有 15 行。

cues.en: That was also the case in Python, and that's because it's the exact same code based on the same idea.
cues.zh: Python 也是 15 行，因為根據同樣想法寫成。

cues.en: And I will explain this idea, that means I will explain how this code works at the end of this tutorial.
cues.zh: 教學最後會說明概念，也就是程式如何運作。

cues.en: But for now, let's select this code and let's see what happens.
cues.zh: 現在先選取，看看結果。

cues.en: So Command or Control + Enter to execute, and let's wait.
cues.zh: 按 Command 或 Control+Enter 執行，等一下。

cues.en: It's taking a little time, that's normal, but it's gonna plot something.
cues.zh: 要花點時間，很正常，不過會畫出圖來。

cues.en: There it is.
cues.zh: 出來了。

cues.en: There it is.
cues.zh: 就在這裡。

cues.en: That's the plot.
cues.zh: 這就是圖。

cues.en: Okay, so for those of you who followed the Python tutorial, we obtain exactly the same plot.
cues.zh: 若看過 Python 教學，會發現完全相同。

cues.en: So let's describe this plot.
cues.zh: 現在描述它。

cues.en: I'm going to enlarge this.
cues.zh: 我將圖放大。

cues.en: Okay, so let's analyze this graph step by step.
cues.zh: 逐步分析。

cues.en: First, let's focus on all the points here.
cues.zh: 先專注在所有點上。

cues.en: We can see that we have some red points and some green points.
cues.zh: 有紅點，也有綠點。

cues.en: So all these points that we see on this graph are the observation points of our training set.
cues.zh: 這些都是訓練集的觀測點。

cues.en: That is, these are all the users of the social network that were selected to go to the training set.
cues.zh: 也就是被選入訓練集的社群網路使用者。

cues.en: And each of these users here is characterized by its age here on the X-axis and its estimated salary here on the Y-axis.
cues.zh: 每個人由 x 軸年齡，及 y 軸估計薪資描述。

cues.en: Now we can see that there are some red points here and some green points here.
cues.zh: 有些紅點，有些綠點。

cues.en: The red points are the training set observations for which the dependent variable purchased is equal to zero.
cues.zh: 紅點是應變數 Purchased=0 的訓練觀測。

cues.en: And the green points are the training set observations for which the dependent variable purchased is equal to one.
cues.zh: 綠點是 Purchased=1。

cues.en: That means that the red points here are the users who didn't buy the SUV and the green points here are the users who bought, who actually bought the SUV.
cues.zh: 所以紅點沒買 SUV，綠點實際買了。

cues.en: So now as a first step of analysis, let's give an interpretation of what we observe here with these users.
cues.zh: 先解讀這些使用者的分布。

cues.en: Okay, so first we can see that the users who are young with a low estimated salary, so these users here, actually didn't buy the SUV.
cues.zh: 首先，年輕且估計薪資低的人，也就是這些點，沒有買 SUV。

cues.en: Then if we look at the users who are older and with a higher estimated salary, well we can see that most of these users actually bought the SUV, and it actually makes sense because the SUV
cues.zh: 年紀較大且薪資較高的人，大多買了，很合理，因為 SUV

cues.en: is more like a family car and therefore more interesting for these older users here with a high estimated salary.
cues.zh: 比較像家庭車，對這些較年長、高薪的人有吸引力。

cues.en: Besides, we can also see that some older people even with a low estimated salary actually bought the SUV, because we can see that we have some green points here that correspond
cues.zh: 也看到一些年長但低薪的人仍然買了，因為這裡有綠點，年齡

cues.en: to an age above the average.
cues.zh: 高於平均，

cues.en: The average is here, but an estimated salary below the average because the average is here, okay?
cues.zh: 平均在這裡；但薪資低於平均，平均在這裡。

cues.en: So these guys, these older guys, although they have a low estimated salary, actually bought the SUV, probably because they've been saving up some money or maybe they finished paying up their mortgage,
cues.zh: 這些較年長、低薪的人可能已存了錢，或還清房貸，

cues.en: I don't know but what's for sure is that they couldn't resist buying this very cool luxury SUV offered at a ridiculously low price.
cues.zh: 我不知道，但確定的是，他們無法抗拒這輛價格低得驚人的豪華 SUV。

cues.en: And on the other hand, we can also see that there are some young people here with a high estimated salary who actually bought the SUV.
cues.zh: 另一方面，也有一些年輕、高薪的人買了。

cues.en: You know, maybe because it's a very cool SUV and they want to impress their friends and take them into road trips.
cues.zh: 可能覺得車很酷，想讓朋友驚豔，帶朋友公路旅行。

cues.en: Or maybe they already have a family.
cues.zh: 或已經有家庭。

cues.en: I don't know.
cues.zh: 我不知道。

cues.en: Anyway, they bought the SUV.
cues.zh: 總之，他們買了。

cues.en: Actually, there are a lot of buyers so this must be a very cool and cheap SUV.
cues.zh: 買家很多，所以車應該又酷又便宜。

cues.en: Okay, and now what is the goal of classification?
cues.zh: 那麼分類的目標是什麼？

cues.en: Now we're talking machine learning.
cues.zh: 現在談機器學習。

cues.en: Why are we making some classifiers and what will classifiers do, at least what are we trying to make them do for this particular business problem?
cues.zh: 為何建立分類器？對這個商業問題，希望它做什麼？

cues.en: Well, the goal here is to classify the right users into the right categories.
cues.zh: 將正確使用者分到正確類別。

cues.en: That is, we are trying to make a classifier that will catch the right users into the right category, which are, yes, they buy the SUV and no, they don't buy the SUV.
cues.zh: 建立分類器，把人分成會買 SUV，與不會買兩類。

cues.en: And we represented the way our classifier catches these users by plotting what are called the prediction regions.
cues.zh: 我們以預測區域，呈現分類器如何分人。

cues.en: And so the prediction regions are the two regions that we see on this graph, this red one here and this green one here.
cues.zh: 圖上兩個區域，就是這裡的紅色與綠色。

cues.en: And the red prediction region is the region where our classifier catches all the users that don't buy the SUV.
cues.zh: 紅色預測區域包含分類器判斷不會買的人。

cues.en: And the green prediction region is the region where our classifier catches all the users that buy the SUV.
cues.zh: 綠色預測區域包含判斷會買的人。

cues.en: But be careful.
cues.zh: 但要小心。

cues.en: This is according to the classifier, that is, for each user of this red prediction region here, our logistic regression classifier predicts
cues.zh: 這是分類器的判斷。紅色區域每個人，邏輯斯迴歸都預測

cues.en: that the user doesn't buy the SUV.
cues.zh: 不會買 SUV。

cues.en: And for each user of this green prediction region here, our classifier will predict that the user buys the SUV.
cues.zh: 綠色區域每個人，都預測會買。

cues.en: So that makes an awesome tool because for each new user of the social network, well, a logistic regression classifier will sell
cues.zh: 這是很強大的工具，對每個新使用者，模型會

cues.en: based on its age and its estimated salary.
cues.zh: 根據年齡與估計薪資，

cues.en: If this user belongs to this red prediction region here and therefore doesn't by the SUV, or if this user belongs to this green prediction region here, and therefore buys the SUV.
cues.zh: 判斷他屬於紅色、不買區域，還是綠色、購買區域。
